Hæc ipsi Paparum assecla. quid Domini Papæ ipsi?
Illinè vt æquis animis hanc crassam, pro sua honorifi-
centia, adulationem sustineant? sustineant vero? imò
eundem honorem, tanquàm proprium sibi vendicant
etiam imperantque. Nam Gregorius VII. Papa, inter pri-
uilegia Rom. Pontificis, nono loco recensuit, quòd {i}Solius
Papa pedes omnes Principes exosculentur. Ità vt in-
ter Pontifices iam nec, ob tyrannidem, Nerones; nec ob
luxuriam, Heliogabali; nec, ob insolentiam, Tarquinij
superbi deesse videantur. Denique in Libro Caremo-
nialium Papalium praescribitur, quòd {k}Omnes Mortales,
cuiuscunque sint dignitatis & praeeminentiæ, cùm primùm in
conspectum Pontificis veniunt, ter debeant ante Illum genu-
flectere, & pedes eius osculari, in honorem Iesu, cuius vicem
gerit. Quamuis apud Lectorem ingenuum hanc tam in-
tolerabilem Pontificum arrogantiam denotâsse, difflâsse[?];
& penitùs dissipâsse sit: nihilominus Argumenta Ad-
uersariorum conuellam, nè se despectos magis quàm
non refutatos esse queritentur.

page.notes: The running head is as printed. The scan has "60" at the foot right, beside the signature. It is not a word, so it is given as the catchword slot, and it may be a printed number. The reference mark "h" appears in the text before "Nos"; the margin note reads "Latin.Ief.in Act" with "10." on the next line. "dict.9." and "difflâsse" are doubtful. The sign before "Argumentum" and before "Amen" is a small hand or dagger-like mark, shown here as {†}. "lauàssel" is doubtful. The Maldonato note is printed as "Com-mem." with a line-end hyphen. The final word "di-" continues on the next page. Stains and show-through are omitted.
